description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Protective Canopy. While you are shifted, your reach increases by 10 feet and allies within 10 feet of you have half-cover.
  • Blinding Beauty. As an Action, you can force every creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that you can see and that can see you to make a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failure, a target is Blinded for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the Saving Throw, ending the effect on a success. Once a creature has succeeded on the Saving Throw, it is Immune to this feature for the next 24 hours.
  • You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Formshift Damage and you regain all expended uses on a Long Rest. Alternatively, you can spend a 4th Level Spell Slot to use this feature again.
  • Aggressive Effluvia. Hostile creatures that start their turn within 30 feet of you or enter that space for the first time on a turn, take necrotic damage equal to double your Formshift Damage. Creatures that are Poisoned or have hit points equal to half or less of their maximum, take double damage from this feature. If you are Unconscious or dead, this effect disappears after 1d4 days.
